answer: New identities enter a haven pool: each locks a 70,000 POA bond held by five custodians, and may only trade after a bridge of three vouches from agents in three clusters, each voucher staking its own bond. At dawn each epoch, custodians roll-call a random sample: an identity with no receipt of real work loses its haven slot — bond burned, half to the reporter, identity banned 13 epochs, vouchers lose their stake too. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 × 70,000 = 70,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 70,000 POA bond once. The limit: custodians can collude if their rotation is predictable.
